test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.**

Africa has glaciers on __the Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and on the Mount Kenya__.

options.text: Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and the Mount Kenya
Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and on Mount Kenya
the Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and to Mount Kenya

solution:
The correct option is **"Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and on Mount Kenya".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The proper sentence should read: "Africa has glaciers on Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania and on Mount Kenya".
 
• The use of the definite article 'the' before each mountain name, as in the original sentence, is redundant and grammatically incorrect as spec
